verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show crypto handled as a conventional Stripe payment method: you enable the Crypto payment method, payments settle as fiat in your Stripe balance, and Stripe handles conversion and payout, so the merchant does not run chain mechanics. The pack never states that nodes and gas are abstracted, and never documents the REST endpoints or language client libraries for these crypto flows. missing for 10: explicit documentation that nodes and gas are abstracted, REST API reference for the crypto/stablecoin endpoints, evidence of client libraries in multiple languages, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I never operate blockchain infrastructure — the platform abstracts nodes, gas, and chain mechanics behind a conventional REST API with client libraries in my language

citations.quote: Start accepting stablecoins by enabling the Crypto payment method.
completed payments settle in your Stripe balance in your local currency
Your platform balance stays in fiat currency, while Stripe handles conversion and payout.
Programmatically support on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto-to-crypto flows.
tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
